calls.summary:
# App Shell Release Plan
Date: 2026-11-05 | Duration: 31.049999237060547m

## Summary
The app shell redesign preserves existing functionality, uses an expanded sidebar by default, and stores the sidebar state. The docked shell will merge into the main PR, but full-page testing is required before rollout. Profile and organization work remains open: the profile icon needs stronger differentiation, the placement of the multiple-organization selector is unresolved, and the enterprise badge needs a premium treatment. The non-Pylon question mark has been removed. The docked AI panel is the highest priority, while its auto-collapse behavior remains debated. Closing the panel restores the expanded sidebar, and a resizable panel handle has been requested. Validation concerns include bottom-left links obscuring the collapse control, potentially using taller buttons for visibility, workspace constraints from expanded panels, and ensuring that super-admin navigation remains accessible.

## Keywords
App shell, Sidebar navigation, Docked AI assistant, Organisation selector, Enterprise badge, Pull request release
